Coerce a conforming producer to a canonical fb_ensemble

Source: R/ensemble_source.R
as_fb_ensemble.Rd

The single ingest entry point for contract C5. Dispatches on the producer: an fb_ensemble is returned unchanged; a pesto_ensemble_manifest (PESTO's S7 calibration manifest) is mapped via the C2 -> C5 bridge; a list carrying params / outputs is wrapped; a length-1 character path is read from disk. Any other class is looked up in the producer registry (register_ensemble_source()) before erroring.

Usage

as_fb_ensemble(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A conforming producer object (see Details / the contract).

...

Passed to the matched coercer.

Value

An fb_ensemble.

See also

inst/ensemble_source_contract.md.

Examples

# an fb_ensemble round-trips unchanged
ens <- fb_ensemble(
  params = data.frame(p1 = runif(10)),
  outputs = data.frame(o1 = runif(10)),
  provenance = list(source = "raw")
)
identical(as_fb_ensemble(ens), ens)
#> [1] TRUE

# a bare list carrying params / outputs is wrapped the same way
as_fb_ensemble(list(params = data.frame(p1 = runif(5)),
                     outputs = data.frame(o1 = runif(5))))
#> -- fb_ensemble (simulation ensemble, contract C5) ----------
#>   source : raw
#>   sets   : 5
#>   params : 1 (p1)
#>   outputs: 1
#>   labelled: FALSE | observed: FALSE
#> ------------------------------------------------------------
